title: aphyllon corymbosum subsp. mutabile
intro: Aphyllon corymbosum subsp. mutabile, commonly known as Green Squill or Mutabilis Squill, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asparagaceae. It is a traditional medicinal plant used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and anti-cancer properties, as well as its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of Aphyllon corymbosum subsp. mutabile include cardiotonic, diuretic, and anti-arrhythmic effects, making it a potential treatment for cardiovascular diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include cardenolides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, and other compounds such as alkaloids and flavonoids.
